title: fix(security)!: under a wall a catalog-carrying package is the platform operator's — install-local and the /packages delete refuse tenants (ADR-0131 D3)
body:
Part of #15204

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

Stage W2 of #15204 (seat note 6114823168): the walled catalog refusal at the package doors. Stage W (#22895) refused catalog writes at `/meta`, the clone door and the data door. This PR refuses them where a package carries them. It asks W's predicate, `walledCatalogWriteVerdict`, from `main`.

## The ruling this executes

ADR-0131 D3: "tenant admins cannot create or edit catalog items; the operator defines the catalog for every tenant (managed packages, Studio)". A package that declares positions, permission sets or capabilities is the operator's instrument. Seat note 6114823168: under `group` / `isolated`, below the operator rung (and not `isSystem`), `install-local` refuses
- an install whose incoming version declares any catalog item;
- an upgrade where either the installed or the incoming version declares any;
- an uninstall of a package whose installed version declares any.

The whole package is refused, since a partial install is not well-formed. The note also asked for a measurement of `DELETE /api/v1/packages/:id`, and for that door to be refused the same way if the measurement showed it reachable.

## Measured first

The harness was a booted `examples/app-crm` stack (`bootStack`, `multiTenant: 'posture-only'`, plus `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin`), with two organizations. Organization A's owner holds `manage_metadata` through a grant scoped to organization A (rung `TENANT_ADMIN`). Organization B's member holds the operator's permission sets.

| Edge (A, below the operator) | `isolated` | `group` | B afterwards |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `install-local` upgrade of the operator's package, adding `manage_users` to its set | 200 | 200 | **gains `manage_users`** |
| `install-local` uninstall of that package | 200 | 200 | **loses the set** |
| `DELETE /packages/:id` of a runtime package the operator saved a set into (`PUT /meta/permission/:name?package=`) | 200 | 200 | **loses the set** |
| `PATCH /packages/:id/disable` of such a package | 200 | n/a | keeps the set (catalog unchanged) |

Those catalog items are stored as `sys_metadata` rows bound to the package (`package_id`). The running registry does not hold them under the package, so the `/packages` refusal reads the stored rows, the same rows `deletePackage` deletes. `disable` changes nothing any organization resolves, so it is not refused.

## What changed

- **`install-local`** (`@objectstack/cloud-connection`): the admission carries the caller's posture rung and the effective tenancy posture, both from its one authorization read. `refuseWalledCatalogPackage` asks `walledCatalogWriteVerdict` once per catalog type that the incoming version, the installed version or the running registry under that id declares. It answers `403 FORBIDDEN`, the envelope of the door's sibling refusals, and runs before any registration or ledger write (install) or before the ledger is touched (uninstall). `error.details.catalogItems` lists the items.
- **`DELETE /packages/:id`** (`@objectstack/runtime`): `refuseWalledCatalogPackageDelete` reads the package's stored rows, and asks the predicate per stored catalog type, after the capability and writable-package gates and before anything is deleted. It answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, this domain's 403. The `packages.ts` comment that called `requireManageMetadata` "the operator gate" now says what that gate checks: the capability or `isSystem`, and no rung.
- **`@objectstack/objectql`** exports `declaredSecurityCatalogNames`, the engine's own reading of what a manifest declares. The door judges the declarations the engine registers, not a second reading of them. `cloud-connection` now depends on `objectql` directly (it was already in its closure through `runtime`).
- **ADR-0087:** the semantic entry `walled-catalog-package-writes-retired`; the changeset carries FROM → TO per door.
- **Docs:** census row 55b names the `/packages` delete and anchors `refuseWalledCatalogPackageDelete`, with the counts regenerated. `capabilities.mdx` gains the clause from W's contract review (6115069587 ③ 3 ii): under a wall a sub-operator caller reads the walled refusal first, `FORBIDDEN` on REST and `PERMISSION_DENIED` on the dispatcher, before the code-only `NOT_CREATABLE`.

## Tests

- `wall-package-refusal.dogfood.test.ts`, 19 tests. Under each of `isolated` and `group`:
  - install refused (a permission set, and a position alone);
  - upgrade refused (the measured edge, and a catalog-free version over an installed catalog-carrying one);
  - uninstall refused;
  - `/packages` delete refused.

  B's resolution does not move. Controls under both postures: A installs, upgrades and uninstalls a catalog-free package and deletes a catalog-free runtime package; the operator installs, upgrades, uninstalls and deletes catalog-carrying packages. `single` control: the same `manage_metadata` holder does all of it as before.
- **Ablation, install-local:** `refuseWalledCatalogPackage` was forced to admit, `cloud-connection` rebuilt, and the marker confirmed in `dist/` by `ablation-dist-preflight`. The 10 install-local refusal pins went red (5 per posture), and the other 9 stayed green. Restored to the `HEAD` blob and rebuilt; the marker is absent from `dist/` and the tree is clean.
- **Ablation, `/packages`:** the same for `refuseWalledCatalogPackageDelete` (`runtime`). The 2 `/packages` refusal pins went red, and the other 17 stayed green. Restored and rebuilt; the marker is absent.

- **Full suites** (pre-merge code head `f4d6a8f104`, the same W2 code as this head): `objectql` 401 files / 7,817 passed; `runtime` 355 files / 5,126 passed, 19 skipped; `cloud-connection` 43 files / 517 passed. The full dogfood suite was stopped when W landed, before it finished, so it is not counted. The pin files are counted on the merged head below.
- **`dispatch-gates --ran`** (pre-merge, 141 derived): 140 exit 0. `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90` refused on this shallow clone (exit 2, nothing measured).
- **Round-1 findings, fixed:**
  - `check:test-source-alias`: `cloud-connection`'s tests now reach `@objectstack/objectql`, so that package's `vitest.config.ts` gained an anchored source alias.
  - `cloud-connection`'s own suite: fake registries lack the private catalog reader. Both doors now ask the predicate before reading anything, so under `single`, with no `tenancy` service, or for the operator, neither door reads anything new.
- **On the merged head `0d0a42082d`:**
  - the pins: `wall-package-refusal` 19/19 and `wall-catalog-refusal` 17/17;
  - `check:system-context-census`, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check:test-source-alias` each exit 0;
  - regeneration (`gen:schema`, `gen:docs`, `gen:system-context-census`) leaves 0 changed bytes.

  The 124 gates `dispatch-gates` derives for this head are running; their verdict goes in the os-dev-report addendum on #15204.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not decided here (the maintainer's):** whether a walled organization's `manage_metadata` may install packages at all, or author the environment's objects, views and flows. This PR refuses only catalog-carrying packages, per 6114823168.
- `refuseSecurityCatalogNameConflicts` (the shadow refusal) is unchanged; this refusal runs before it.
